description: Prices for one Arena instrument's YES on Kalshi and, while Arena shows them, on Novig and Polymarket for the same instrument, side by side. Every price is a probability from 0 to 1 for the instrument's YES (its label), whatever side of the venue's market was read. Each row names its venue and when its bid and ask were current (as_of); a last_trade has no time of its own and can be older than as_of. Its notes say how that venue's contract differs from Kalshi's, whether a person has reviewed the match, and that Novig's public prices can be 5 to 10 seconds old at the source. Rows come in a fixed order (Kalshi, Novig, Polymarket), not ranked by price. Arena is paper trading: it does not route orders to Kalshi, Novig or Polymarket and has no partnership with any of them; each price is the venue's own. For members, place_trade defaults to route=best, so a paper trade can fill at Novig's or Polymarket's price when it passes Arena's checks; route=kalshi, and any trade by an account without a membership, fills at Kalshi's price. The receipt names the venue. When cross_venue is false, Arena is not showing other venues right now and only Kalshi is listed. ref takes an instrument id (ins_...), a slug, a Kalshi ticker, or a bet in words such as 'chiefs ml' or 'mia +3.5'; words use the first match, earliest game first. When asked_side is no, the words or the ticker name the instrument's NO, whose chance is 1 minus these prices. No sign-in needed. Set full=true for every raw field; the notes stay.
